description: PAIRED marketplace engine — API service (pairedart.com). M1: identity + shared plumbing. M2: artist profiles, verification, listings, uploads, Connect onboarding. M3: commerce & fulfillment — checkout with the 7-condition buy-door recheck, orders/payments/fulfillments/ledger as separate records, Stripe webhooks through the durable inbox, per-kind fulfillment state machines, and the release engine (transfer != payout).
name: paired-engine
